title: How to Find Broken Images in WordPress
description: A practical guide outline for finding missing image references before they damage a site’s reader experience.
metaDescription: Editorial preview: a future KreativWP guide to finding broken images in WordPress.
intro: This planned guide will explain a maintenance workflow and link to the relevant KreativWP product where that is useful, without treating the product as the only option.

sections.title: Look beyond the media library
sections.body: Broken references can appear in older content, imported posts, templates, and external image sources.

sections.title: Create a repeatable check
sections.body: A documented periodic check is more dependable than noticing missing images after readers report them.

sections.title: Fix the cause, not only the symptom
sections.body: A good cleanup considers redirects, migrated file paths, and the content process that produced the broken reference.
